bio.text: Chris Todd represents House District 3, which covers a portion of Hilo and nearby communities, in the Hawaii House of Representatives.
Todd was appointed by Governor David Ige on January 5, 2017 to fill the vacancy caused by the death of Representative Clift Tsuji.
Born and raised in Hilo, Todd holds a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from the University of Hawaiʻi at Hilo.
